name: MtButton 按钮

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: 主操作：新建/推送/生成，实心墨蓝
次操作：编辑/筛选，描边或幽灵

representativeVariants.name: Primary md
representativeVariants.whySelected: 全站出现频率最高的主操作按钮
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: 「新 建」「推 送」「生 成」等 2-3 字动词（AntD 双字按钮含字间空格）

representativeVariants.name: Secondary md
representativeVariants.whySelected: 表格行内编辑、取消等次操作
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: 「编 辑」「取 消」「同步 PR 状态」

representativeVariants.name: Danger md
representativeVariants.whySelected: 删除类破坏性操作，与错误语义色一致

representativeVariants.name: Ghost sm
representativeVariants.whySelected: 卡片/工具条内轻量动作，表格批量工具条 32px 密度

anatomy.structure: single inline-flex, center aligned, gap var(--space-1)

structurePatterns: 同排多按钮：主操作居右，次操作向左排
危险操作与主操作之间隔 var(--space-2)
loading 态：文字保留 + spinner 替换 leading icon

rules: 文案动词开头，双字词加全角空格
一屏内 primary 按钮只出现一个

unknowns: link 变体在暗色侧栏中的对比度待实测
keyInsightSeed: 墨蓝实心主按钮，工房密度 36px 默认高，克制圆角与按压反馈
